exact_response: Integration can be a worthwhile goal if it means participating in shared civic life, building relationships, and respecting others’ rights. That expectation should apply equally to everyone, without requiring Asian people to abandon their cultures or treating them as outsiders. Many are already longstanding members of their societies.
